جُلَّةٌ A large [receptacle made of palm-leaves woven together, such as is called] قُفَّة, for dates; (K;) a receptacle (S, Mgh, Msb, K) for dates, (S, Mgh, Msb,) made of palm-leaves; (K;) [a thing made of palm-leaves woven together, generally used as a receptacle for dates, but also employed for other purposes, as, for instance, to lay upon the mouth of a watering-trough, where the water is poured in, by way of protection; see إِزَآءٌ:] pl. جِلَالٌ (Mgh, Msb, K) and جُلَلٌ. (K.) ＝
-A2- See also جَلَّهٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
